label: Save Properties
description: Saves plain text values from the submitted data onto the item this request is about. Which properties may be saved, and which must have a value, are set on this step rather than chosen by the caller.

editable.label: Editable properties
editable.description: The properties a caller may save. Any other submitted entry is ignored rather than refused.

required.label: Required properties
required.description: The editable properties that must have a value; refused when blank.
